zh-CN.followUp:
后台任务已结束：{{command}}（{{status}}，退出码 {{exitCode}}）

这是应用在后台任务结束后发起的跟进，用户可能不在电脑前。请用 job_status 查看任务 {{jobId}} 的日志，必要时读取这些新产生或改动的文件：{{artifacts}}。然后用两三段话向研究者汇报：实际发生了什么、结果说明了什么（区分观测与推断）、有哪些异常或需要核验的地方，以及你建议的下一步。本轮只能阅读和记录，不要尝试运行新任务或修改文件；下一步由研究者决定。
zh-CN.brief: 请为我准备今天的研究简报。用 research_search 和 research_executions 回顾最近 24 小时：完成了什么、实际运行了哪些任务及结果、哪些 Agent 交接或结论仍待核验、有哪些需要我来决定的事，以及你建议今天优先做的一两件事。简短、具体，区分已核实与未核实。本次只阅读和总结，不运行命令、不修改文件。
zh-CN.weeklyOutline: 本周进展、关键结果与证据、遇到的问题与失败、待核验事项、下周计划、需要导师或合作者决定的事。
zh-CN.groupMeetingOutline: 按幻灯片组织：研究问题与动机、方法、主要结果（每页附证据引用）、负结果与局限、下一步、希望讨论的问题。
zh-CN.restoreLabel: 恢复检查点前自动保存

en.followUp:
Background job finished: {{command}} ({{status}}, exit code {{exitCode}})

The app started this follow-up after the job ended; the researcher may be away. Use job_status to read the log of job {{jobId}} and read these new or changed files if useful: {{artifacts}}. Then report in two or three short paragraphs: what actually happened, what the result shows (separating observation from inference), anything unusual or worth checking, and the next step you suggest. This turn can only read and record. Do not try to run new jobs or change files; the researcher decides what happens next.
en.brief: Please prepare today's research brief for me. Use research_search and research_executions to review the last 24 hours: what was done, which jobs actually ran and their results, which agent handoffs or conclusions are still unverified, what needs my decision, and the one or two things you suggest prioritising today. Keep it short and concrete, separating verified from unverified. Only read and summarise; do not run commands or change files.
en.weeklyOutline: Progress this week, key results with evidence, problems and failures, items to verify, plan for next week, decisions needed from the advisor or collaborators.
en.groupMeetingOutline: Organised by slide: question and motivation, method, main results (with evidence citations on each slide), negative results and limits, next steps, questions for discussion.
en.restoreLabel: Saved automatically before restoring a checkpoint
